Cc: Derek Shaw <cto@aurionix.com>

Subject: Sustained 5xx + p95 spike - embeddings path (private deployment)

Markus —

We're seeing sustained elevated p95 (~2.0s) for embeddings and intermittent 5xx responses from our private VPC deployment that started ~06:00 PT. The rate has been climbing since early morning and now 15% of requests are returning 502/503; throughput has dropped by ~30% despite steady incoming traffic. Attached are a small bundle of logs and a p95 timeline.

This is causing production search degradation for our customers (sessions failing). We need a remediation plan and an ETA for rollback or temporary mitigation. Please escalate — Derek is copied.

Attachments: aurionix-logs-20280602.tar.gz, p95-trend-2028-06-01-06-02.png

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>

Date: 2028-06-02T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Sustained 5xx + p95 spike - embeddings path (private deployment)

Update (initial triage):
- Environment: aurionix-prod-vpc, model: embedding-compact-v2 (quantized), nodes: 6 r5-gpu-custom
- Symptoms: rising queue depth on worker nodes, high decoder error counts tied to one node (node-03). Logs show repeated "KV cache stale" warnings and intermittent decoder OOMs in the same window as 502s.
- Throughput drop is correlated with autoscaler scaling down one pool when transient errors spike (we observed a scale-down at 06:12).

Hypothesis: a single node hitting decoder memory pressure + autoscaler reacting to errors reduced capacity -> amplification of latency and 5xx. Initial mitigations to try (in order):
1) Pin traffic away from node-03 (drain) and temporarily disable autoscale down for the pool.
2) Increase worker concurrency limit from 8 -> 12 for this customer only (provides more parallelism while we stabilize).
3) If decoder OOMs persist, switch to fallback model variant (embedding-compact-v2-safe) with lower memory footprint for 30m.

I will execute 1) immediately and report back in 10m with node drain confirmation.

--
Irene Choi
Sr. SRE, Runtime Performance | Redwood Inference

We appreciate the rapid escalation — I'll log a formal severity report on our side and will expect the postmortem link.
